newsitem.title: THAILAND: Thai baht steady late, interbank rate down.
newsitem.headline: Thai baht steady late, interbank rate down.

text.p: The Thai baht was nearly unchanged against the dollar in late Friday trade despite the U.S. unit's rebound abroad, dealers said.
Dealers said market activities were slow in the absence of major players from Singapore due to a public holiday there.
The baht was at 26.072/26.077 to the dollar late against 26.073/26.076 earlier, dealers said.
"Only local players were in the market. Most of them had squared positions and did not want to trade today," said one dealer at a local bank.
The mid-rate was set unchanged at 26.08 to the dollar.
The overnight interbank rate edged down to 7.75-8.00 percent late from 8.00-8.25 in the morning on easing liquidity, dealers said.
"Some banks were lending their surplus funds into the market today after they maintained sufficient cash for the reserve deadline next week," one money market dealer said.
All commercial banks have to meet the Bank of Thailand's reserve requirements on seventh and 22nd of each month.
The one-month baht/dollar swap premium was down to 5.00/6.00 satangs per dollar late compared with 5.25/6.25 in early trade, dealers said.
